sections.Profile:
Wild Card , released by Williams Electronic Games in 1977, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Steve Kordek with artwork by Christian Marche.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Gambling, Card games, Casino, Original Theme, 1970s
